title: LLMs Depend on Specialist Tools for Out-of-Distribution Generalization in MS/MS Structural Elucidation
title_zh: LLM在MS/MS结构解析的分布外泛化中依赖专用工具

paragraphs.en: ML4Molecules: Agentic Systems for Molecular Sciences
paragraphs.zh: ML4Molecules：面向分子科学的智能体系统

paragraphs.en: A frontier language model was recently reported to solve 1D NMR structural elucidation without tools. We ask whether this capability transfers to tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) in the de novo setting, where the model must propose a structure directly from the spectrum without a candidate list or reference library. To separate reasoning from recall, we build a 100-analyte benchmark from MassSpecGym, split by each analyte’s textual footprint into in-distribution (well documented in literature) and out-of-distribution (essentially undocumented) arms. We hold the model, harness, and output format fixed and vary only the LLM’s access to domain-specific tools. Without tools, a frontier LLM reaches 52% Top-1 accuracy in-distribution but only 2% out-of-distribution. Only access to de novo structure generators improves out-of-distribution accuracy, raising it to as much as 38% Top-1, and the resulting agent outperforms the standalone de novo models both in and out of distribution. These results suggest that LLMs are not effective at de novo MS/MS structural elucidation on their own, and that further gains depend on the specialist tools available to the agent rather than on the LLM itself.
paragraphs.zh: 据报道，一个前沿语言模型最近无需工具即可完成一维核磁共振（1D NMR）结构解析。 我们探究这种能力是否能迁移到从头解析场景下的串联质谱（MS/MS）中，在该场景下模型必须直接从谱图提出结构，而没有候选列表或参考库。 为了将推理与记忆区分开，我们基于 MassSpecGym 构建了一个包含 100 个分析物的基准，按每个分析物的文本足迹划分为分布内（文献中有充分记载）和分布外（几乎没有记载）两组。 我们保持模型、运行框架和输出格式不变，仅改变 LLM 对领域专用工具的访问权限。 在无工具情况下，前沿 LLM 在分布内达到 52% 的 Top-1 准确率，但在分布外仅有 2%。 只有访问从头结构生成器才能提升分布外准确率，最高可提升至 38% 的 Top-1，且由此得到的智能体在分布内和分布外的表现均优于独立的从头结构生成模型。 这些结果表明，LLM 仅靠自身无法有效地完成从头 MS/MS 结构解析，进一步的提升取决于智能体可使用的专用工具，而非 LLM 本身。

paragraphs.en: Tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) is the dominant approach for identifying unknown small molecules in complex mixtures. Its sensitivity extends to trace quantities that are inaccessible to nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy [ 13 , 30 ] . MS/MS takes an ionized precursor compound and breaks it into fragments, each of which contains a mass and an intensity. Inferring a compound’s identity from its spectrum, a process called structural elucidation , is a central problem in the field of mass spectrometry. This task remains largely unsolved, with most spectra detected in a sample never assigned to a structure. These spectra are known colloquially as the “dark matter” of metabolomics [ 26 ] .

paragraphs.en: The standard method for structural elucidation is library matching , which compares a query spectrum against a library of experimentally measured reference spectra and ranks the candidate identities by fragmentation-pattern similarity [ 19 ] . The coverage of library matching is bounded by the size of its spectral libraries, which typically contain 10 4 10^{4} – 10 5 10^{5} distinct structures [ 5 ] , orders of magnitude fewer than the ∼ 10 8 {\sim}10^{8} compounds cataloged in PubChem [ 17 , 7 ] . Furthermore, library-based approaches cannot identify a compound that has never been measured, a category that includes many novel drug metabolites and environmental transformation products. Identifying these compounds requires a class of structural elucidation named de novo generation . De novo elucidation, a form of inverse structural elucidation , generates a candidate structure directly from an MS/MS spectrum, and is the most challenging formulation of structural elucidation. On MassSpecGym, the community-accepted benchmark for this task, the state-of-the-art de novo Top-1 accuracy is 23.9% [ 3 , 38 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 结构解析的标准方法是库匹配，即将查询谱图与实验测得的参考谱图库进行比对，并根据碎片模式相似度对候选身份进行排序 [ 19 ] 。 库匹配的覆盖范围受其谱图库规模的限制，这些谱图库通常只包含 10 4 10^{4} – 10 5 10^{5} 种不同的结构 [ 5 ] ，比 PubChem 中收录的约 10 8 {\sim}10^{8} 种化合物少了几个数量级 [ 17 , 7 ] 。 此外，基于库的方法无法识别从未被测量过的化合物，而新型药物代谢物和环境转化产物中有许多正属于此类。 识别这些化合物需要一类被称为从头生成的结构解析方法。 从头解析是逆向结构解析的一种形式，它直接从 MS/MS 谱图生成候选结构，是结构解析中最具挑战性的形式。 在该任务公认的社区基准 MassSpecGym 上，最先进的从头生成 Top-1 准确率为 23.9% [ 3 , 38 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Recent work reports strong zero-shot performance of frontier LLMs on the inverse elucidation problem in NMR spectroscopy. In Making Claude a Chemist [ 15 ] , Claude Opus 4.7 was given fifteen 1D inverse elucidation problems, each supplying 1 H and 13 C peak lists, molecular formulae, and, for the seven hardest spectra, the reaction’s starting material. With no tools and no chemistry-specific fine-tuning, a setting that mirrors de novo elucidation, it returned the published structure on at least two of three attempts for every compound. Because the compounds were taken from preprints posted after the model’s training cutoff, the result cannot be attributed to memorization.
paragraphs.zh: 近期工作报道了前沿大语言模型在核磁共振波谱反演解析问题上展现出强劲的零样本性能。 在 Making Claude a Chemist [ 15 ] 一文中，Claude Opus 4.7 被给出了十五道一维反演解析题，每道题提供了 1 H 和 13 C 峰列表、分子式，其中七道最难的谱图还附带了反应的起始原料。 在不使用工具、也没有经过化学领域微调的设定下（这一设定对应从头解析的情形），该模型对每个化合物都在三次尝试中至少两次返回了已发表的结构。 由于这些化合物取自该模型训练截止日期之后发布的预印本，因此该结果不能归因于记忆效应。

paragraphs.en: This work asks whether the zero-shot structural elucidation performance reported for Claude Opus on NMR [ 15 ] translates to MS/MS. This translation is not guaranteed, as chemical shift in NMR reflects each nucleus’s local environment and is approximately additive, making the substructure-to-shift mapping compositional [ 28 ] . By contrast, MS/MS fragmentation is stochastic and non-local, proceeding through charge migration, rearrangement, and competing dissociation channels [ 13 ] , so fragments vary with adduct and instrument [ 33 , 5 ] . Unlike NMR shifts, MS/MS spectra therefore cannot be reliably predicted, or inverted, from substructure rules alone.
paragraphs.zh: 本工作探究 Claude Opus 在核磁共振（NMR）上报告的零样本结构解析性能 [15] 是否能迁移到质谱/质谱（MS/MS）。 这种迁移并非理所当然，因为 NMR 中的化学位移反映每个原子核的局部环境并近似具有可加性，使得亚结构到位移的映射具有组合性 [28]。 相比之下，MS/MS 碎裂是随机的且非局部的，通过电荷迁移、重排和相互竞争的解离通道进行 [13]，因此碎片会随加合物和仪器而变化 [33, 5]。 与 NMR 位移不同，因此 MS/MS 谱图无法仅凭亚结构规则被可靠地预测或反演。

paragraphs.en: We additionally explore whether an LLM with tools, an agent, can improve de novo elucidation performance. In other chemistry domains, tools cover capabilities that a base model lacks [ 23 , 4 ] , but the benefit is task-dependent and can be negative for competent LLMs [ 37 ] . No equivalent attribution exists for MS/MS, where published comparisons of agents with and without tools reduce to a single all-or-nothing contrast between the full toolbox and none of it [ 34 ] . Furthermore, without a careful ablation of the tools used in an agent, it is challenging to determine whether an agent came to an answer via reasoning over its tool outputs, or memorization (recall) over its training data.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还进一步探究了配备工具的大语言模型（即智能体）能否提升从头解析的性能。 在其他化学领域中，工具弥补了基础模型所缺失的能力 [ 23 , 4 ] ，但其收益取决于具体任务，对于能力较强的 LLM 甚至可能是负面的 [ 37 ] 。 MS/MS 领域尚无对应的归因研究，已发表的智能体有无工具的对比仅简化为“完整工具箱与完全没有工具”这一全有或全无的单一对照 [ 34 ] 。 此外，如果不对智能体所使用的工具进行细致的消融实验，就很难判断智能体得出答案究竟是通过对工具输出的推理，还是通过对其训练数据的记忆（回忆）。

paragraphs.en: Contributions. To evaluate the de novo MS/MS elucidation capabilities of agentic LLMs, we contribute the following. (a) We construct a 100-spectrum MS/MS benchmark from the MassSpecGym test fold. This benchmark contains two sets of spectra matched on acquisition conditions but with a different literature footprint, separating memorization from reasoning-based elucidation. (b) We show that, without tools, the LLM’s accuracy tracks a compound’s literature footprint rather than the information in its spectrum. It reaches 52% Top-1 accuracy on well-documented in-distribution (ID) compounds but only 2% on out-of-distribution (OOD) compounds. (c) We attribute performance to individual tools by ablation under a fixed harness, finding that subformula annotation and forward prediction only improve performance on in-distribution analytes, while a de novo generator raises out-of-distribution accuracy to 12–38%. (d) We show that this out-of-distribution gain is bounded by the candidates the generator proposes, with the LLM acting as a better re-ranker.
paragraphs.zh: 贡献。 为了评估智能体化大语言模型（LLM）的从头 MS/MS 解析能力，我们做出了以下贡献。 (a) 我们基于 MassSpecGym 测试折构建了一个包含 100 张谱图的 MS/MS 基准。 该基准包含两组谱图，它们的采集条件相匹配，但文献覆盖度不同，从而将记忆与基于推理的解析区分开来。 (b) 我们表明，在不使用工具的情况下，大语言模型的准确率追踪的是化合物的文献覆盖度，而非其谱图中的信息。 对于文献记载丰富的分布内（ID）化合物，其 Top-1 准确率达到 52%，但在分布外（OOD）化合物上仅有 2%。 (c) 我们在固定的评测框架下通过消融实验将性能归因到各个单独的工具，发现子式标注和前向预测仅能提升分布内分析物的性能，而从头生成器将分布外准确率提升至 12–38%。 (d) 我们表明，这一分布外性能提升受限于生成器所提出的候选物，此时大语言模型扮演着一个更出色的重排序器角色。

paragraphs.en: Benchmark Creation. This work seeks to compare in-distribution versus out-of-distribution performance of LLMs on structural elucidation. However, frontier models rarely disclose their training data, making it difficult to determine whether they have encountered a given compound. We therefore use a molecule’s textual footprint , defined as the number of PubMed records linked to the compound in PubChem [ 18 ] , as a proxy for whether an analyte exists in an LLM’s training data. The intuition behind this choice is that frontier models are extensively trained on scientific literature, and compounds that are more prevalent in literature are more likely to exist in an LLM’s training dataset, thus becoming in-distribution. Our benchmark is split into two arms (Figure 1 , Appendix Table 2 ). The textually out-of-distribution (OOD) arm selects analytes with zero linked PubMed records, no Medical Subject Headings (MeSH) entry, and a systematic (IUPAC) PubChem title, whereas the textually in-distribution (ID) arm selects analytes with at least 100 linked PubMed records, a MeSH entry, and a common-name title. Note that, given our benchmark setup, “OOD” here refers to the textual distribution alone and does not imply chemical novelty.
paragraphs.zh: 基准构建。 本工作旨在比较大型语言模型在结构解析任务上分布内与分布外的表现。 然而，前沿模型很少披露其训练数据，因此难以判断它们是否接触过某个给定化合物。 因此，我们使用分子的文本足迹（即 PubChem 中与该化合物关联的 PubMed 记录数量 [18]）作为该分析物是否存在于大语言模型训练数据中的代理指标。 这一选择背后的直觉是：前沿模型在科学文献上接受了大量训练，在文献中出现频率更高的化合物更可能存在于大语言模型的训练数据集中，从而成为分布内样本。 我们的基准分为两个分支（图 1，附录表 2）。 文本分布外（OOD）分支选取没有关联 PubMed 记录、没有医学主题词表（MeSH）条目、且 PubChem 标题为系统命名（IUPAC）的分析物；而文本分布内（ID）分支选取至少有 100 条关联 PubMed 记录、有 MeSH 条目、且标题为常用名的分析物。 请注意，在我们的基准设定下，这里的“OOD”仅指文本分布，并不意味着化学上的新颖性。

paragraphs.en: Task and Metrics. All experiments use the same task. Given the ( m/z , intensity ) peaks of an MS/MS spectrum, the precursor m/z , and the precursor’s neutral molecular formula, identify the precursor molecule, returning k = 5 k=5 ranked candidate structures as SMILES. We evaluate performance using Top-1 and Top-5 accuracy, where a prediction is counted as correct if the 2D InChIKey of any of the Top- k k generated molecules matches that of the ground-truth precursor. The 2D InChIKey is the first 14-character block of the full InChIKey, and encodes molecular connectivity but not stereochemistry. We additionally measure molecular similarity of generated molecules against their ground truth via Tanimoto@1 over 2048-bit ECFP4 fingerprints and MCES@1, a graph edit distance.
paragraphs.zh: 任务与指标。 所有实验均使用相同的任务。 给定 MS/MS 谱图的（m/z，强度）峰、前体的 m/z 以及前体的中性分子式，识别前体分子，以 SMILES 形式返回 k=5 个排序候选结构。 我们使用 Top-1 和 Top-5 准确率评估性能，若生成的 Top-k 分子中任意一个的 2D InChIKey 与真实前体的 2D InChIKey 匹配，则该预测计为正确。 2D InChIKey 是完整 InChIKey 的前 14 个字符块，编码分子连接性但不编码立体化学信息。 我们还通过基于 2048 位 ECFP4 指纹的 Tanimoto@1 和 MCES@1（一种图编辑距离）来衡量生成分子与真实分子之间的分子相似度。

paragraphs.en: Harness. In order to adequately assess tool contribution to structural elucidation, the agent harness is fixed for all experiments and only the tool set varies. Query spectra, model, output contract, parser, scorer, sampling parameters, and turn budget are identical across experiments. All experiments run Claude Opus 5 at high reasoning effort with a 64,000-token output allowance and a ceiling of twenty tool calls per query. Every tool run shares one system prompt and differs only in the attached tool definitions, so differences among them are attributable to the tools alone. The LLM baseline experiment uses a modified prompt which omits tool descriptions. Each analyte is elucidated with fresh context, and all tool outputs are screened to ensure no ground-truth annotations were leaked to the agent. Analytes are re-run under the same configuration until every experiment reports 100 usable answers (Appendix C ).
paragraphs.zh: 智能体框架（Harness）。 为了充分评估工具对结构解析的贡献，所有实验均固定使用相同的智能体框架，仅工具集不同。 查询谱图、模型、输出契约、解析器、评分器、采样参数以及轮次预算在所有实验中完全一致。 所有实验均以高推理强度运行 Claude Opus 5，输出上限为 64,000 个 token，每次查询的工具调用上限为二十次。 每个工具运行共享同一个系统提示词，仅附加的工具定义不同，因此它们之间的差异可完全归因于工具本身。 LLM 基线实验使用修改后的提示词，其中省略了工具描述。 每个分析物均在全新上下文中进行解析，并对所有工具输出进行筛查，以确保没有任何真值标注泄露给智能体。 分析物在相同配置下重复运行，直到每个实验均报告 100 个可用答案（附录 C）。

paragraphs.en: Tools. Three tools are available to the agent: subformula annotation returns a subformula for every peak in an MS/MS spectrum that is consistent with the parent formula, forward prediction simulates an MS/MS spectrum from a SMILES string, and de novo generation attempts to identify structures directly from the spectrum, returning a list of candidate SMILES. Subformula annotation and forward prediction let an agent test candidate identities. De novo generators instead propose those identities, shifting the agent’s work from generating candidates to evaluating them. These tools are provided to the agent via two interchangeable tool suites. The public suite uses MIST-CF’s subformula annotation script [ 10 ] for subformula annotation, GLACIER [ 32 ] for forward prediction, and MS-GPT [ 38 ] and FRIGID [ 3 ] for de novo generation. As of the time of experimentation (August 2026), MS-GPT and FRIGID are the current and previous state-of-the-art de novo identification models on the MassSpecGym benchmark. The in-house suite substitutes proprietary models for subformula annotation and de novo generation while retaining GLACIER. We denote our in-house generator LSM-Gen , a de novo model from our LSM (Large Spectral Model) family [ 1 ] , retrained for this paper.

paragraphs.en: Experiments. Experiments are cumulative, each adding one tool at a time. L0 is the LLM-only baseline. Given that no tools are used for this experiment, whatever performance it achieves comes only from pattern recognition, chain-of-thought reasoning, and memorization. L1 adds subformula annotation, removing peak assignment from the model’s own arithmetic. L2 adds forward prediction, used to test candidate structures once they are predicted. L3 adds de novo generation, which provides the agent with a set of candidate structures that it can then test. At L3 the generated structures are added to the agent’s candidate set, not swapped in for it. Each generator model is also run standalone as a non-agentic baseline.

paragraphs.en: Unaided LLMs are retrieval engines. At L0 the LLM’s Top-1 accuracy is 52% (26/50) for ID analytes and 2% (1/50) for OOD analytes (Table 1 ). Because the benchmark arms do not separate on adduct, precursor m / z m/z , or peak count (Appendix B ), a 50-point gap cannot be attributed to spectral difficulty. Tanimoto@1 further separates them by a large margin ( 0.66 0.66 against 0.31 0.31 ); the OOD predictions are not merely mis-ranked but structurally wrong. In contrast to the LLM baseline’s 2%, the best de novo models achieve 18% and 32% Top-1 accuracy on the OOD arm. Undocumented compounds are therefore identifiable from their spectra alone, so the LLM’s ID/OOD gap is not explained by OOD spectra being less informative. Instead, it suggests that the LLM’s in-distribution accuracy reflects memorized knowledge of documented compounds rather than reasoning over the spectrum from first principles.
paragraphs.zh: 未经增强的大语言模型是检索引擎。 在 L0，大语言模型对 ID 分析物的 Top-1 准确率为 52%（26/50），对 OOD 分析物为 2%（1/50）（表 1）。 由于基准测试各分支在加合形式、母离子 m/z（precursor m/z）或峰数量上并无区分（附录 B），50 个百分点的差距不能归因于谱图难度。 Tanimoto@1 进一步将两者大幅拉开（0.66 对 0.31）；OOD 的预测不仅是排序错误，而是结构上完全错误。 与大语言模型基线的 2% 相比，最好的从头预测模型在 OOD 分支上达到了 18% 和 32% 的 Top-1 准确率。 因此，未收录的化合物可以仅凭其谱图被识别出来，所以大语言模型的 ID/OOD 差距无法用 OOD 谱图信息量较低来解释。 相反，这表明大语言模型的分布内准确率反映的是对已收录化合物的记忆性知识，而非基于第一性原理对谱图进行推理。

paragraphs.en: Tools help and de novo generators enable OOD. Subformula annotation (L1) and forward prediction (L2) improve ID Top-1 accuracy from 52% at L0 to 62% and 56% respectively, but leave OOD unchanged at 2%. Adding a de novo generator raises OOD Top-1 to 12% with FRIGID, 26% with MS-GPT, and 38% with LSM-Gen , lifting performance across all 100 analytes to 40%, 56%, and 59% respectively. The two hypothesis-testing tools, forward prediction and subformula annotation, contribute only toward identifying ID analytes, whereas the tools that propose candidate structures enable OOD hits. Forward prediction is also mildly counterproductive where it does act, costing six points of ID Top-1 in L2 relative to L1. Across all experiments, at most 14% of errors occur in cases where the agent had the correct structure but failed to return it first. In nearly all of the remainder, the structure was never proposed by the agent or its tools (Appendix Figure 6 ). This finding suggests that the generation of plausible chemical structures, rather than the ranking of candidates once proposed, is the primary bottleneck of agentic reasoning in de novo MS/MS elucidation.
paragraphs.zh: 工具提供帮助，而从零生成器则实现了分布外（OOD）能力。 子式标注（L1）和前向预测（L2）将分布内（ID）Top-1 准确率从 L0 的 52% 分别提升至 62% 和 56%，但 OOD 准确率保持 2% 不变。 加入从零生成器后，FRIGID 将 OOD Top-1 提升至 12%，MS-GPT 提升至 26%，LSM-Gen 提升至 38%，并使全部 100 个分析物的整体性能分别提升至 40%、56% 和 59%。 前向预测和子式标注这两种假设检验工具仅有助于识别 ID 分析物，而提出候选结构的工具才能实现 OOD 命中。 前向预测在其发挥作用的地方甚至略有负面影响，相对于 L1，L2 中的 ID Top-1 损失了六个百分点。 在所有实验中，最多只有 14% 的错误发生在智能体已拥有正确结构却未能将其置于首位返回的情况下。 在其余几乎全部错误中，该结构从未被智能体或其工具提出过（附录图 6）。 这一发现表明，生成合理的化学结构，而非对已提出候选的排序，才是从零 MS/MS 解析中智能体推理的主要瓶颈。

paragraphs.en: The de novo models in L3 generate a set of candidates for the agent to interrogate. The agent’s task therefore shifts from generating candidates to ranking them. The agent is good at candidate re-ranking in both benchmark arms. When the true structure is present in the de novo model’s candidate set, it correctly ranks this structure as its top answer for 93–97% of ID analytes and 67–95% of textually OOD analytes (Figure 2 ). Given that OOD analytes carry no PubMed-linked records or MeSH entry, this re-ranking is unlikely to occur due to recall, and instead demonstrates the agent’s reasoning capabilities over its tool outputs.
paragraphs.zh: L3 中的从头生成模型会产生一组候选结果，供智能体进行审查。 因此，智能体的任务从生成候选结果转变为对它们进行排序。 在两个基准测试组中，智能体都擅长对候选结果进行重新排序。 当从头生成模型的候选结果集中包含真实结构时，对于 93–97% 的 ID 内分析物和 67–95% 的文本 OOD 分析物，智能体都能将该结构正确排在首位答案（图 2）。 鉴于 OOD 分析物没有 PubMed 关联记录或 MeSH 词条，这种重新排序不太可能是由于记忆召回，而是展示了智能体对其工具输出进行推理的能力。

paragraphs.en: The agent may also return structures its generator never produced, so its accuracy can in principle exceed the generator’s candidate coverage , the fraction of spectra whose true structure appears anywhere in the de novo model’s generated candidates. On the ID arm it does: 68% against a coverage of 30% for FRIGID, 86% against 58% for MS-GPT, and 80% against 64% for LSM-Gen . That amounts to 20, 15, and 9 correct structures the generator tool’s pool never held, and each of the three gains over the generator alone is significant (exact McNemar, p < 0.01 p<0.01 ). On the OOD analytes, the agent’s own proposed candidates add little. The agent’s accuracy with MS-GPT and LSM-Gen no longer clears its generator’s coverage, reaching 26% against 36% for MS-GPT and 38% against 40% for LSM-Gen (Figure 2 ). FRIGID is the one case where the agent does reach outside the candidate pool, but the two structures it gains are offset by two in-pool structures it loses, leaving 12% against a coverage of 12%. This difficulty generating identity candidates out-of-distribution suggests that an agent is best equipped to adjudicate over the candidate identities provided by its tools, rather than to attempt to generalize on its own.

paragraphs.en: Our work shows that, without tools, a frontier model’s MS/MS de novo identification accuracy tracks how much has been written about a compound rather than what its spectrum contains. This shortcoming can be addressed by giving an agent a de novo generator tool, over whose candidates an agent is an effective re-ranker. The approach presented here is not without limitations, which we outline below.

paragraphs.en: The difference in ID/OOD performance is not unique to the LLM, which limits what these experiments can attribute to it. In the LLM baseline experiment, Top-1 accuracy falls from 52% on ID analytes to 2% on OOD, a factor of 26. However, the performance of all three generator-only runs falls as well, though by a much smaller factor of roughly two to four (24% to 6% for FRIGID, 48% to 18% for MS-GPT, and 60% to 32% for LSM-Gen ). One explanation is that ID analytes have closer structural analogues in the generators’ encoder training data. All three de novo models condition on encoders trained with the same PubChem-derived dataset of synthetic spectra, from which test structures are removed by exact InChIKey match only, leaving close analogues in place. Nearest-neighbor similarity of test-set analytes to that dataset splits by benchmark arm (ECFP4 Tanimoto median 0.90 ID against 0.82 OOD, Appendix F ). Future work should therefore remove close analogues from the encoder’s training data, not just exact matches. Importantly, this is not direct leakage since the synthetic spectra in the encoder’s training dataset are simulated by a forward model trained only on MassSpecGym’s training split, so the models never see an experimental spectrum of any test compound.

paragraphs.en: Our results carry further limitations. Firstly, textual footprint is a proxy for out-of-distribution which we cannot verify without observing the LLM’s training datasets. Training datasets of frontier models are undisclosed and these analytes do exist in PubChem, so a compound with no literature record may still have been seen. Secondly, other forms of MS/MS leakage in the LLM may exist. In Appendix G , we observe a significant improvement in performance on analytes whose PubChem pages contain MS/MS spectra. Thirdly, we evaluate a single model at a single date, without sweeping providers, temperatures, or token budgets. Finally, Opus 5 is not uniformly the strongest LLM on scientific tasks [ 20 ] , so the experiment’s absolute numbers should be read as one configuration rather than a frontier.

paragraphs.en: Unlike in NMR, a frontier model alone cannot perform de novo structural elucidation of tandem mass spectra. Opus 5 zero-shot identifies 27% of our benchmark spectra, but these are almost exclusively well-cited compounds, and Top-1 accuracy falls from 52% to 2% between in- and out-of-distribution analytes. When integrated with specialist tools in an agentic framework, an LLM outperforms state-of-the-art de novo generator models both in and out of distribution, although its out-of-distribution performance remains limited by the candidates its de novo generator provides. Future efforts to annotate a larger share of the dark matter of metabolomics will therefore require both better de novo models and more sophisticated agents that draw on a wider range of structural elucidation tools.
paragraphs.zh: 与核磁共振不同，仅靠前沿模型无法对小分子串联质谱图进行从头结构解析。 Opus 5 在零样本条件下能识别我们基准测试中 27% 的谱图，但这些几乎全都是被大量引用的已知化合物，且其 Top-1 准确率在分布内与分布外分析物之间从 52% 骤降至 2%。 在智能体框架中与专业工具结合后，大语言模型在分布内和分布外场景下的表现均优于最先进的从头生成模型，尽管其分布外性能仍受限于其从头生成模型所提供的候选结构。 因此，未来要解析代谢组学中更大比例的“暗物质”，既需要更好的从头生成模型，也需要更复杂的智能体，以调用更广泛的结构解析工具。

paragraphs.en: Routine annotation matches an observed spectrum against reference libraries by cosine, modified-cosine, or spectral-entropy similarity, and is therefore restricted to compounds a library already contains. Structural retrieval relaxes this constraint by matching predicted fingerprints [ 10 , 8 ] or through in-silico spectra [ 31 , 33 , 32 ] to structure databases like PubChem. Both approaches assume that the structure of interest already exists in some library or database, which is an assumption that does not hold for novel or uncharacterized analytes.
paragraphs.zh: 常规注释通过余弦相似度、修正余弦相似度或谱熵相似度将观测谱与参考库进行匹配，因此仅限于库中已有的化合物。 结构检索通过匹配预测指纹 [ 10 , 8 ] 或通过计算机模拟谱图 [ 31 , 33 , 32 ] 来匹配 PubChem 等结构数据库，从而放宽了这一限制。 这两种方法都假定目标结构已经存在于某个库或数据库中，而对于新型或未表征的分析物来说，这一假设并不成立。

paragraphs.en: De novo structural elucidation methods overcome the limitations of library matching by generating a structure directly from the spectrum. Early fingerprint-to-structure decoders [ 29 ] were followed by formula-conditioned generative models, including diffusion over molecular graphs and sequences [ 3 ] . Current state-of-the-art public models score roughly 24% Top-1 accuracy on chemically OOD test sets [ 38 ] . In order to read our results against the state-of-the-art, we used the top two de novo models available at the time of experimentation in August 2026.

paragraphs.en: Off-the-shelf LLMs have previously been observed to fail outright at direct spectra-to-structure prediction: prompted with chain-of-thought on MassSpecGym, four LLMs return no exact match at Top-10 accuracy, against 4.25% for a spectrum-trained diffusion baseline [ 35 ] . Agentic framings have been more productive. The GNPS2 framework couples an LLM to tools for MS/MS alignment, formula decomposition, structural enumeration, substructure mapping, spectral prediction, and validation against mass, adduct, and retention time; it recovered several previously unannotated metabolites, later confirmed experimentally [ 34 ] . MSAgent orchestrates an LLM with more than fifty domain-specific tools, reporting MRR gains above 10 % 10\% on CASMI retrieval and roughly 40 % 40\% mean Tanimoto improvement when refining de novo outputs on CANOPUS, both against a tool-free GPT-4o arm [ 21 ] . MS4MS pairs a fine-tuned domain model with a formula agent and an identification agent that cosine-matches spectral libraries and reasons over the retrieved neighbors, reporting 92.0 % 92.0\% Top-1 formula accuracy on the same MassSpecGym test fold used here [ 11 ] . MetaboT routes an LLM over a metabolomics knowledge graph through entity resolution, schema-aware SPARQL generation, and query refinement, reporting 83.7 % 83.7\% accuracy on forty-nine expert-authored questions against 8.2 % 8.2\% for single-shot GPT-4o [ 2 ] . MetaboAnnotate uses a multi-agent setup which predicts molecule identities using consensus voting over three orthogonal forward prediction (in-silico fragment generation) tools, reporting 36.5 % 36.5\% and 28.2 % 28.2\% Top-1 retrieval on CASMI 2016 and 2022 respectively [ 39 ] . Three limits follow from these existing agents. First, each agent couples retrieval or database lookup to whatever generative capability it has and reports a single identification number over the combination, so none isolates de novo generation performance. Second, each is evaluated in a tool-maximal configuration, compared either against an external baseline or against the same model stripped of every tool at once. Therefore, the marginal contribution of any one component cannot be measured. Third, every tool-free arm in this literature, including the chain-of-thought benchmark above, runs on GPT-4o, GPT-5 nano, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, or a fine-tuned 14B model, so the systems are not measured using a frontier model.
paragraphs.zh: 此前已有观察表明，现成的大语言模型在直接从光谱到结构的预测任务上会完全失败：在 MassSpecGym 上以思维链方式提示时，四个大语言模型的 Top-10 准确率均无任何精确匹配，而经过光谱训练的扩散基线为 4.25% [ 35 ] 。 智能体式的框架则更有成效。 GNPS2 框架将大语言模型与多种工具耦合，包括 MS/MS 对齐、分子式分解、结构枚举、子结构映射、光谱预测，以及基于质量、加合物和保留时间的验证；该框架恢复了若干此前未被注释的代谢物，并随后得到实验证实 [ 34 ] 。 MSAgent 用一个智能体调度大语言模型与五十多个领域专用工具协作，报告在 CASMI 检索上 MRR 提升超过 10% 10\%，在 CANOPUS 上对从头生成结果进行精修时平均 Tanimoto 相似度提升约 40% 40\%，两者均以无工具的 GPT-4o 作为对照 [ 21 ] 。 MS4MS 将一个微调的领域模型与一个分子式智能体和一个鉴定智能体配对，后者通过余弦匹配光谱库并对检索到的近邻进行推理，报告在本文所用同一 MassSpecGym 测试折上取得 92.0% 92.0\% 的 Top-1 分子式准确率 [ 11 ] 。 MetaboT 通过实体消解、模式感知的 SPARQL 生成和查询精修，将大语言模型路由到代谢组学知识图谱上，报告在四十九个专家撰写的问题上取得 83.7% 83.7\% 的准确率，而单次调用的 GPT-4o 仅为 8.2% 8.2\% [ 2 ] 。 MetaboAnnotate 采用多智能体设置，通过对三个正交的正向预测（计算机模拟碎片生成）工具进行共识投票来预测分子身份，报告在 CASMI 2016 和 2022 上分别取得 36.5% 36.5\% 和 28.2% 28.2\% 的 Top-1 检索结果 [ 39 ] 。 这些现有智能体存在三个局限。 首先，每个智能体都将检索或数据库查询与其所具备的生成能力耦合在一起，并只报告该组合的单一鉴定数值，因此没有一个工作能够孤立地衡量从头生成的性能。 其次，每个系统都在工具最大化的配置下进行评估，要么与外部基线比较，要么与被一次性剥离所有工具的同一模型比较。 因此，无法衡量任何单一组件的边际贡献。 第三，该文献中所有无工具的对照，包括上述思维链基准，均运行于 GPT-4o、GPT-5 nano、Claude-3.5-Sonnet 或微调的 14B 模型之上，因此这些系统并未使用前沿模型进行测量。

paragraphs.en: Memorization in LLMs has also been studied directly. The likelihood that a model memorizes a fact grows log-linearly with how often that fact is duplicated in pretraining [ 6 ] , and accuracy on factual questions tracks how many pretraining documents mention both the question and its answer, a dependence that scaling alone is unlikely to remove [ 16 ] . Retrieval augmentation helps most on questions about less popular subjects [ 24 ] . Our agent experiments test this same interaction in a setting where the retrieved object is a molecular structure rather than a fact.

Unlike MetFrag, however, we use documentation not as a ranking signal but as a proxy for how likely a model is to recall a compound rather than identify it from spectral evidence.

paragraphs.en: This work interrogates LLM performance on MS/MS structural elucidation across in- and out-of-distribution settings. In order to estimate whether an analyte is in-distribution to a language model’s training dataset, we measure its textual footprint . To measure this footprint, we construct a local snapshot of PubChem using the bulk NCBI distributions for InChIKeys, synonyms, titles, PubMed associations, MeSH terms, patents, and depositor records. Analytes from MassSpecGym are then joined to these PubChem entries via their 2D InChIKey connectivity block (first 14 characters of the InChIKey). 10 out of 2,992 MassSpecGym test-fold analytes cannot be joined because their 2D InChIKey after analyte standardization does not exist in PubChem. Multiple PubChem CIDs may map to one 2D InChIKey, so we measure literature prevalence using the maximum number of linked PubMed records among CIDs sharing the same 2D InChIKey block.
paragraphs.zh: 本工作考察了大语言模型在分布内和分布外设置下进行 MS/MS 结构解析的性能。 为了估计某个分析物是否位于语言模型训练数据集的分布内，我们测量其文本足迹。 为测量该足迹，我们使用 NCBI 批量发布的数据构建了 PubChem 的本地快照，涵盖 InChIKey、同义词、标题、PubMed 关联、MeSH 术语、专利以及提交者记录。 然后通过 2D InChIKey 连接块（InChIKey 的前 14 个字符）将 MassSpecGym 的分析物与这些 PubChem 条目进行关联。MassSpecGym 测试集 2,992 个分析物中有 10 个无法关联，因为其标准化后的 2D InChIKey 在 PubChem 中不存在。 多个 PubChem CID 可能映射到同一个 2D InChIKey，因此我们使用共享同一 2D InChIKey 块的 CID 中关联 PubMed 记录数量的最大值来衡量文献流行度。

paragraphs.en: We then construct a 100-analyte benchmark containing two sets of 50 analytes (Table 2 ). The textually OOD arm contains compounds with zero linked PubMed records, no MeSH annotation, and a PubChem display title classified as systematic (IUPAC-like), whereas the in-distribution arm requires at least 100 linked PubMed records, a MeSH annotation, and a common-name title. MassSpecGym often holds several spectra for the same analyte, so we only keep the spectrum with the median peak count to ensure (analyte, spectrum) uniqueness. Importantly, “OOD” here refers specifically to the textual distribution : these compounds lack the literature indexing and common names that could give a language model an obvious memorized structure–name association. It does not imply that they are chemically out of distribution for a molecular structure model, or that they are absent from the LLM’s training data altogether.

Across the 100 spectra, the two arms do not differ in adduct ( p = 0.68 p{=}0.68 ), precursor m / z m/z ( p = 0.98 p{=}0.98 ), or fragment-peak count ( p = 0.70 p{=}0.70 ). sents.en: In order to keep textual distribution as our primary independent variable, we control for how we sample spectra between ID and OOD datasets.
sents.zh: 为了使文本分布保持为我们的主要自变量，我们对分布内与分布外数据集之间的谱图采样方式进行了控制。

sents.en: We sample 50 out-of-distribution analytes under a fixed random seed and pair each with the closest in-distribution analyte by precursor m / z m/z and fragment-peak count, and where possible by adduct (matched in 48 of 50 pairs) and instrument type (41 of 50).
sents.zh: 我们在固定随机种子下采样50个分布外分析物，并将每个分析物与前体 m/z 和碎片峰计数最接近的分布内分析物配对，并在可能的情况下按加合物（50对中有48对匹配成功）和仪器类型（50对中有41对）进行匹配。

sents.en: Across the 100 spectra, the two arms do not differ in adduct ( p = 0.68 p{=}0.68 ), precursor m / z m/z ( p = 0.98 p{=}0.98 ), or fragment-peak count ( p = 0.70 p{=}0.70 ).
sents.zh: 在这100张谱图中，两组在加合物（p = 0.68）、前体 m/z（p = 0.98）或碎片峰计数（p = 0.70）方面均无差异。

sents.en: Collision energy was not matched and differs slightly between arms (median 45 eV ID against 30 eV OOD, p = 0.045 p{=}0.045 ; recorded for 79 of 100 spectra).
sents.zh: 碰撞能量未进行匹配，且在两组之间略有不同（分布内组中位数为45 eV，分布外组为30 eV，p = 0.045；100张谱图中有79张记录了该信息）。

paragraphs.en: Every agent calls Claude Opus 5 through the AWS Bedrock Mantle endpoint, pinned by model identifier, with adaptive extended thinking at high reasoning effort, and a 64,000-token output allowance per turn.
paragraphs.zh: 每个智能体都通过 AWS Bedrock Mantle 端点调用 Claude Opus 5，以模型标识符进行固定，启用高推理强度的自适应扩展思考，并且每轮拥有 64,000 个 token 的输出额度。

paragraphs.en: Each agent is defined by a folder containing its system prompt, its query template, and the list of tools it may call. The query template controls what the model can see: it names the fields it accepts, and rendering fails both when one of those fields is missing and when we pass a field it does not name. Appendix H gives the prompts for the baseline and every agent.
paragraphs.zh: 每个智能体由一个文件夹定义，其中包含其系统提示词、查询模板以及它可以调用的工具列表。 查询模板控制模型能看到的内容：它声明了自己接受的字段，当这些字段之一缺失，或我们传入了一个它未声明的字段时，渲染都会失败。 附录 H 给出了基线以及每个智能体的提示词。

paragraphs.en: For each query, we run the following loop. Call the model, run any tools it asks for, append the results, and repeat until it answers or hits a ceiling of 20 tool calls. We keep the model’s own previous turns in the conversation, including its reasoning traces, so each step builds on the last. The ceiling was never reached.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个查询，我们运行以下循环。 调用模型，运行它请求的任何工具，追加结果，然后重复这一过程，直到它给出答案或达到 20 次工具调用的上限。 我们在对话中保留模型自己之前的轮次，包括其推理痕迹，因此每一步都建立在上一步的基础上。 该上限从未被触及。

paragraphs.en: Thinking tokens are drawn from the same allowance as the answer, so a hard spectrum can exhaust the budget while reasoning and return nothing. The exhausted turn is then echoed back with a single instruction to emit the answer from the analysis already performed.
paragraphs.zh: 思考标记与最终回答共用同一额度，因此长推理链可能在推理阶段就耗尽预算，导致什么都不返回。 耗尽额度的那一轮会被回显，并附带一条指令，要求基于已完成的推理直接输出回答。

paragraphs.en: The endpoint expects well-formed JSON outputs for each analyte prediction. A prediction that fails to parse is rerun until we generate a well-structured result.
paragraphs.zh: 该端点要求每个分析物的预测结果均为格式良好的 JSON 输出。 无法解析的预测会被重新运行，直到生成结构良好的结果为止。

paragraphs.en: Arguments are validated before a tool runs, and a malformed call is returned to the model as a correctable error rather than raised as an exception that would kill the spectrum. Tool results are memoized on the tool, its version, the validated arguments, and the spectrum identifier, in a store scoped by a fingerprint of the dataset, so a repeated call within or across runs is served from the store rather than recomputed. This decision was made for cost-saving purposes. Because the cache is an artifact of our re-runs rather than a property of the method, the tool costs reported in Appendix D charge every call at its full service time, cache hits included. Note that the agent cannot access the filesystem or execute code; tool calls are HTTP calls to remote-hosted services running the models, and the agent had no access to any ground-truth data during the course of these experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 参数在工具运行前会经过校验，格式错误的调用会作为可纠正的错误返回给模型，而不是以会中断频谱的异常形式抛出。 工具结果会基于工具本身、其版本、校验后的参数以及频谱标识符进行记忆化存储，存储按数据集的指纹划分作用域，因此在单次运行内或跨运行中重复的调用会直接从存储中读取，而无需重新计算。 这一决定是出于节省成本的考虑。 由于缓存是我们多次重跑产生的结果，而非方法本身的属性，附录 D 中报告的工具成本按每次调用的完整服务时间计费，缓存命中也不例外。 请注意，智能体无法访问文件系统或执行代码；工具调用是对托管远程服务的 HTTP 调用（这些服务运行着相关模型），并且智能体在这些实验过程中无法访问任何真实标注数据。

paragraphs.en: Agentic workflows, particularly those using frontier models, can be expensive. We report per-spectrum cost by experiment, the GPU time the tools consume, and the cost of an actual identification.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体式工作流，尤其是使用前沿模型的工作流，可能成本高昂。 我们按实验报告每个光谱的成本、工具消耗的 GPU 时间，以及一次实际鉴定所需的成本。

paragraphs.en: Bedrock does not return a per-request price, so costs are inferred from the token counts that the harness records. We cost every LLM call at the list price for Claude Opus 5 as of August 2026, 5 USD per million input tokens and 25 USD per million output tokens, and read the result as an upper bound for cost across experiments rather than as a billed amount.
paragraphs.zh: Bedrock 不会返回每次请求的价格，因此成本是根据测试框架记录的 token 数量推断得出的。 我们按照 2026 年 8 月 Claude Opus 5 的标价为每一次 LLM 调用计算成本，即每百万输入 token 5 美元、每百万输出 token 25 美元，并将结果解读为各实验成本的上限，而非实际计费金额。

paragraphs.en: We report GPU time rather than wall-clock time, since tool requests queue behind one another and observed duration reflects load rather than computation. Each generator was timed on twenty spectra spanning the benchmark’s peak-count range, at the sampling budget the agent uses: 400 draws for FRIGID and 2,000 each for MS-GPT and LSM-Gen . Mean service times are 37.4 s, 31.6 s, and 40.5 s, respectively. Other tools are negligible by comparison (0.5 s per GLACIER call, under 0.1 s for subformula annotation). GPU time is priced at the on-demand rate of a g5.16xlarge instance (4.096 USD per hour).
paragraphs.zh: 我们报告的是 GPU 时间而非实际耗时（wall-clock time），因为工具请求会排队依次执行，观察到的时长反映的是负载而非计算本身。 每个生成器均在覆盖该基准峰值数范围的二十条光谱上、按智能体所用的采样预算进行计时：FRIGID 为 400 次抽取，MS-GPT 和 LSM-Gen 各为 2,000 次。 平均服务时间分别为 37.4 秒、31.6 秒和 40.5 秒。 相比之下，其他工具的开销可忽略不计（GLACIER 每次调用 0.5 秒，子式标注不足 0.1 秒）。 GPU 时间按 g5.16xlarge 实例的按需费率计价（每小时 4.096 美元）。

paragraphs.en: The highest-performing agents (L3 + MS-GPT, L3 + LSM-Gen ) are the cheapest in the agentic ladder, at 1.15 to 1.26 USD per spectrum against 1.27 at L0 and 1.58 at L1. Without a generator the model spends its output allowance enumerating and rejecting candidates from memory, and frequently exhausts it; given a generator it answers in three tool calls and roughly three quarters of the output tokens. Because accuracy rises at the same time, cost per correct identification falls by a factor of 2.3, from 4.70 USD at L0 to 2.05 at the cheapest L3 experiment.
paragraphs.zh: 表现最好的智能体（L3 + MS-GPT、L3 + LSM-Gen）在智能体阶梯中成本最低，每张频谱为 1.15 至 1.26 美元，而 L0 为 1.27 美元，L1 为 1.58 美元。 没有生成器时，模型会耗用其输出配额从记忆中列举并否决候选者，且经常耗尽配额；给定生成器后，它通过三次工具调用和大致四分之三的输出 token 即可作答。 由于准确率同时提升，每次正确识别的成本下降了 2.3 倍，从 L0 的 4.70 美元降至最便宜 L3 实验的 2.05 美元。

paragraphs.en: Our work leverages three de novo generators, one of which is an in-house model ( LSM-Gen ), whose architecture we do not disclose. We audit the data provenance of all three models.

paragraphs.en: We adopt the decoder-side leakage standard established by MassSpecGym v1.5 [ 22 ] . Decoders are typically trained on large unlabeled molecular corpora with test compounds excluded only by exact 2D InChIKey match, a criterion that is much weaker than the MCES ≥ 10 \geq 10 separation that defines generalization in MassSpecGym. A decoder may therefore satisfy exact-match decontamination while retaining a dense structural neighborhood around each test compound, and recover targets by local interpolation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用 MassSpecGym v1.5 [22] 所确立的解码端泄漏标准。 解码器通常在大型无标注分子语料库上训练，仅以精确匹配的 2D InChIKey 一致作为排除测试化合物的标准，这一标准远弱于在 MassSpecGym 中定义泛化的 MCES ≥ 10 ≥ 10 的分离阈值。 因此，一个解码器可能通过精确匹配的去污染检测，同时在每个测试化合物周围保留密集的结构邻域，并通过局部插值恢复目标结构。

sents.en: We adopt the decoder-side leakage standard established by MassSpecGym v1.5 [ 22 ] .
sents.zh: 我们采用 MassSpecGym v1.5 [22] 所确立的解码端泄漏标准。

sents.en: Decoders are typically trained on large unlabeled molecular corpora with test compounds excluded only by exact 2D InChIKey match, a criterion that is much weaker than the MCES ≥ 10 \geq 10 separation that defines generalization in MassSpecGym.
sents.zh: 解码器通常在大型无标注分子语料库上训练，仅以精确匹配的 2D InChIKey 一致作为排除测试化合物的标准，这一标准远弱于在 MassSpecGym 中定义泛化的 MCES ≥ 10 ≥ 10 的分离阈值。

sents.en: A decoder may therefore satisfy exact-match decontamination while retaining a dense structural neighborhood around each test compound, and recover targets by local interpolation.
sents.zh: 因此，一个解码器可能通过精确匹配的去污染检测，同时在每个测试化合物周围保留密集的结构邻域，并通过局部插值恢复目标结构。

paragraphs.en: FRIGID is pretrained on the SAFE-GPT molecule collection of Noutahi et al. [25] with all NPLIB1 and MassSpecGym test and validation structures masked using an exclusion list of connectivity-based (2D) InChIKeys. The authors additionally retain 17% of SAFE-GPT strings that could not be parsed into molecular structures, using all-zero conditioning. These records admit no computable InChIKey and therefore fall outside the exclusion list.

paragraphs.en: Despite this finding, this leakage via PubChem may only partially explain why certain analytes were identified zero-shot by the LLM. Within the in-distribution arm, the LLM identifies 72% of analytes with a PubChem MS/MS entry against 32% without ( p = 0.01 p{=}0.01 ). That 32% is still far above the LLM’s 2% on the OOD arm, so literature footprint must account for much of the gap. Furthermore, the exposure route of displayed MS/MS spectra on PubChem entries to an LLM’s training dataset is narrow. Each record lists only five peaks, and for 13 of the 31 analytes the MS/MS spectrum is only reachable through a salt or stereoisomer record. We nonetheless report this finding as an additional explanation for the strong zero-shot elucidation performance of LLMs on in-distribution analytes.

paragraphs.en: Tools fix non-commitment. Figure 6 assigns every spectrum exactly one outcome, either a correct identification or a failure group. The most common failure is that the agent never commits to an answer within its token budget. Without tools, the model commits to a structure within its token budget on 68% and 46% of spectra for the ID and OOD datasets respectively. Adding a generator nearly eliminates these token budget overflows, reducing them from 54% of OOD spectra at L0 to 6% at L3 with LSM-Gen . What remains as the dominant failure in both arms is spectra whose true structure was never proposed by any model or tool.

The tool-free LLM baseline necessarily differs, because the instructions describing tool use do not apply.
